prBodyNotes: This PR only changes `.vortex-version`. CI stays red until the Go implementation follows upstream `{{{currentVersion}}}` to `{{{newVersion}}}`. The procedure is in [docs/upstream-update.md](../blob/main/docs/upstream-update.md).

packageRules.description: tools/variantjson must use the arrow-rs version that the pinned vortex crates depend on: two arrow-array majors in one build do not type-check (arrow 60 broke Build on 2026-11-21). A major of these crates comes with a Vortex update, never alone.

The vortex crates of tools/* follow .vortex-version: they move with a Vortex update (the vortex-data PR and docs/upstream-update.md), never alone. A lone cargo bump of vortex 0.94.0 was automerged on 2026-11-24 and broke Build (the pin tests want the same version as .vortex-version).
